consequence.statement: Setting the ValidateCAA feature gate no longer has any effect; it does nothing except print a warning log line.
consequence.remediation: Remove the ValidateCAA feature gate from configuration.

original.statement: The deprecated feature gate ValidateCAA is removed; setting it is now a no-op that only prints a warning log line.

decision.reason: [ev-853844eb542e] says the ValidateCAA feature gate is removed and that setting it "is now a no-op which does nothing but print a warning log line". That means a configured value is no longer honoured, which is the definition of setting-ignored. The proposed statement says the same thing, the remediation (remove the gate from configuration) follows from it, and low severity is reasonable because the only visible symptom the evidence names is a warning log line.
